name: Arc OG social card — sticker logo on salmon grain by arc.net
description: This 1200×630 OG card is a single-object composition: the interlocking-loop 'A' mark sits dead centre, rendered as a die-cut sticker with a thick white border and soft shadow, floating on a flat salmon-pink field (~#F29EA4) with a fine grain overlay. There is no headline, wordmark or URL — the mark alone carries the brand, and gradient strokes (light-to-deep blue, coral-to-rose) give it dimension against the flat background. The ~65% negative space and radial symmetry make it instantly legible even at tiny link-preview thumbnail sizes.
